dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor irregular deviations observed along the right lateral margin; left margin is relatively uniform until the posterior convergence.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-reflectance dorsal surface with minimal tonal shifts.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small dark focal mark on the right side of the lower dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Transverse linear indentation visible approximately 80 percent down the visible body length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal crease or healed mark located near the base of the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dorsal ridge exhibiting a linear highlight and localized chromatic fringe along the apex.
